{{Family name hatnote|lang=Spanish|Rodriguez Hertz|Frugoni}}
'''María Alejandra''' ('''Jana''') '''Rodriguez Hertz Frugoni''' (born 1970) is an Argentine and Uruguayan mathematician, professor, and researcher.

==Biography==
Rodriguez Hertz was born on February 11, 1970,<ref name=cv2017/> in [[Rosario, Santa Fe|Rosario]], Argentina.<ref>{{cite news|title=La matemática debería dar placer; en eso estamos allando|url=https://www.elpais.com.uy/domingo/la-matematica-deberia-dar-placer-en-eso-estamos-fallando|lang=es|newspaper=[[El País (Uruguay)]]|date=26 April 2015|first=Gabriela|last=Vaz|access-date=2024-05-27}}</ref> She studied mathematics at the Facultad de Ciencias Exactas, Ingeniería y Agrimensura of the [[National University of Rosario]], Rosario, Argentina, earning a bachelor's degree there in 1994. She earned a doctorate from the [[University of the Republic (Uruguay)|University of the Republic]] in [[Montevideo]], Uruguay, in 1999.<ref name=cv2017>{{cite web|url=https://math.sustech.edu.cn/media/files/Jana2017CV.pdf|title=Curriculum vitae|year=2017|publisher=Southern University of Science and Technology, China|access-date=2024-05-27}}</ref>

Formerly a professor at the Faculty of Engineering at the University of the Republic,<ref name="1-fing">{{cite web |title=Curriculum Vitae María Alejandra RODRIGUEZ HERTZ FRUGONI |url=https://www.fing.edu.uy/~jana/cvuy012010.pdf|year=2010 |website=fing.edu.uy |publisher=Facultado de Ingenieria Universidad del la Republica Uruguay |access-date=30 August 2021}}</ref> she became the first and only woman with a Grade 5 in mathematics in Uruguay.<ref name="2-elobservador">{{cite news |title=Jana Rodríguez Hertz, fórmula guerrera |url=https://www.elobservador.com.uy/nota/jana-rodriguez-hertz-formula-guerrera--20147118160 |access-date=30 August 2021 |work=El Observador |date=1 July 2014}}</ref> Since 2016 she has been a professor at the [[Southern University of Science and Technology]] in China.<ref name=cv2017/>

In 2016, Rodriguez Hertz was elected a Regional Vice President, Latin America & the Caribbean, of the [[Organization for Women in Science for the Developing World]] for the period of 2016–20.<ref name="3-owsd">{{cite web |title=OWSD Elects Regional Vice Presidents for 2016-2020 |publisher=Organization for Women in Science for the Developing World (OWSD) |url=https://owsd.net/news/news-events/owsd-elects-regional-vice-presidents-2016-2020 |website=owsd.net |access-date=30 August 2021 |date=18 May 2016}}</ref>

==Contributions==
Rodriguez Hertz works on [[dynamical system]]s and [[ergodic theory]]. 

Since 2011, Rodriguez Hertz has been involved in the Uruguayan educational debate. She has participated in numerous interviews, public events and conferences on the subject. She has developed a critical point of view on the educational budget, [[Programme for International Student Assessment|PISA]] tests, teaching career development, and other topics. Her particular point of view made her a benchmark of public opinion on the issues.<ref name="4-prouniversitarios">{{cite news |last1=Lasarte |first1=Andrés |title=Un cambio de paradigma – Jana Rodríguez Hertz |publisher= PRO Universitarios |url=http://pro-universitarios.com/jana-rodriguez-hertz-un-cambio-de-paradigma/ |access-date=30 August 2021 |date=9 March 2015 |language=es}}</ref><ref name="5-canalm">{{cite news |title=CON FALDAS: Jana Rodríguez Hertz |url=https://www.canalm.tv/Canal-M/-uc242358 |access-date=30 August 2021 |work=canalmvd |publisher=Canal M |date=12 August 2014 |language=es}}</ref> She has been a columnist in different media, highlighting her participation in 2014 in the "La Tertulia" episode of the program ''En Perspectiva'' by [[Emiliano Cotelo]] on [[El Espectador 810|Radio El Espectador]], as well as the "Jana y sus hermanas" and the "Suena Tremendo" episodes on the same radio station.<ref name="6-espectador">{{cite news |title=Jana y sus hermanas |url=https://espectador.com/suenatremendo/jana-y-sus-hermanas |access-date=30 August 2021 |work=espectador.com |publisher=El Espectador |date=19 August 2016 |language=es-UY}}</ref> She is also the author of the blog, "¿Y por qué no?".<ref name="7-columnistasmontevideo">{{cite web |title=¿Y por qué no? |url=http://columnistas.montevideo.com.uy/categoria_24802_1_1.html |website=Montevideo Portal |access-date=30 August 2021}}</ref>

== Awards and honours ==
* 1992, Premio Jóvenes Notables, Fundación Bolsa de Comercio de [[Buenos Aires]].
* 1999, Investigadora Grado 3, PEDECIBA Matemática.
* 2004, Premio Fondo Nacional de Investigadores, CONICYT.
* 2009, Investigadora Nivel II, Sistema Nacional de Investigadores, SNI, ANII.
* 2013, Investigadora de Primer Nivel, Grado 5, Programa de Desarrollo de las Ciencias Básicas (PEDECIBA).
